Metadata.title: Ram Farid — Full-stack JavaScript Engineer
Metadata.description: Ram Farid is a full-stack JavaScript engineer in Cairo, building fast, clear web apps with Next.js, React and Node.js.

descriptions.details: What the project is called and where it lives. The title, kind and summary show on the portfolio and the home page.
descriptions.timeline: When the work ran and what it was built with. The case study shows the timeline and the tools with their logos.
descriptions.media: The cover leads the portfolio frame and the home band. The gallery is the case study’s screens, in this order.
descriptions.story: The case study’s three parts: the overview, what you delivered, and how you built it. Publishing needs all of them in both languages.

hints.kind: A short label, like Web app or Online store.
hints.slugChanged: Saving moves the case study from <path>/portfolio/{slug}</path>; the old address stops working.
hints.summary: One sentence: what it is and who it’s for.
hints.starred: Shows a Recommended badge on the portfolio and the case study. It doesn’t change the order.
hints.ongoing: Leave empty while the work is ongoing.
hints.coverAlt: What the cover shows, for people who can’t see it.
hints.overview: Two or three sentences: the client, the problem and what the product does now. Blank lines start a new paragraph.
hints.story: Write in Markdown; it’s styled as you type, the way the case study shows it. Raw HTML is removed on save.
